name: Bench Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down along a flat bench with your hip creases positioned at the edge and grip the sides of the bench securely.
Let your legs hang down cleanly past the end with a tiny unlock in your knees.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to raise both legs smoothly upward until they align straight with your torso.
Pause briefly at horizontal, then lower your legs slowly back below the bench under control.
tips: Keep your lower ribs and hips grounded against the bench rather than hyperextending your lower back.
Control the descent smoothly without swinging your legs underneath the bench.
